배.x: Korean pears are big and sweet.
배.e: Same sound as 배 (belly) and 배 (boat). Korean pears are big, round and crisp.
배.t: 배 also means 'stomach' and 'boat' — context tells you which.

배.x: I skipped lunch, so I'm hungry.
배.e: Also means pear and boat — context tells you which.
배.t: 배가 고프다 = hungry, 배가 부르다 = full, 배가 아프다 = stomachache.

배.x: We took a boat to the island.
배.t: 배 also means 'belly' and 'pear'. 배가 아파요 = my stomach hurts; 배를 타요 = I take a boat.

고르다.forms: 골라요 · 골랐어요 · 고를 거예요 · 고르세요 (르 irregular)
고르다.m: to choose, to pick, to select
고르다.t: 르 irregular: 르 + 아 → ㄹ라 — 고르다 → 골라요.

고르다.ex: 올해는 비가 고르게 와서 농사가 잘됐어요.
고르다.x: The rain fell evenly this year, so the harvest went well.
고르다.e: Homonym warning: 고르다 also means 'to choose'. Context tells which.
고르다.t: Most often seen as the adverb 고르게 (evenly), e.g. 고르게 섞다, 고르게 바르다.

피우다.m: to smoke (a cigarette); to make (a fire) burn; to make (flowers) bloom
피우다.x: You're not allowed to smoke here.
피우다.e: Causative of 피다 (to bloom, to burn): 'make something bloom or burn.'
피우다.t: Standard Korean is 담배를 피우다; you'll hear 담배를 피다 in speech, but avoid it in writing.

모시다.m: to take, to accompany (honorific); to live with and care for (elders)
모시다.x: On the weekend I took my grandmother to the hospital.
모시다.t: Use 모시고 가다 for elders, 데리고 가다 for kids or friends.

등록하다.m: to register, to enroll, to sign up
등록하다.ex: 다음 달부터 요가 학원에 등록할 거예요.
등록하다.x: I'm going to sign up for a yoga studio starting next month.
등록하다.e: Literally 'enter into the record' — put your name on the list.
등록하다.t: Pronounced [등노카다]: ㄹ after ㅇ turns to ㄴ, and ㄱ+ㅎ becomes ㅋ.

통장.x: I checked how much money was left in my account.
통장.e: A little ledger book that records money passing in and out.

돌잔치.x: I went to my nephew's first birthday party and gave a present.
돌잔치.e: 돌 'first birthday' + 잔치 'feast'; the baby picks an object (돌잡이) said to predict its future.

극복하다.ex: 그녀는 어려운 환경을 극복하고 의사가 되었어요.
극복하다.x: She overcame difficult circumstances and became a doctor.
극복하다.t: Pronounced [극뽀카다]: the ㅂ is tensed, and ㄱ plus ㅎ becomes ㅋ.

이루다.m: to achieve, to accomplish; to form, to make up
이루다.x: I worked hard and finally achieved my dream.
이루다.e: Its passive 이루어지다 means 'to come true': 꿈이 이루어지다.
이루다.t: Common collocations: 꿈을 이루다 'achieve a dream' and 목표를 이루다 'reach a goal'.

일상생활.ex: 스마트폰은 일상생활에 꼭 필요한 물건이 됐어요.
일상생활.x: Smartphones have become essential in everyday life.

마라톤.ex: 저는 내년에 마라톤 대회에 참가할 거예요.
마라톤.x: I'm going to take part in a marathon next year.
마라톤.t: Say 마라톤을 뛰다 for 'run a marathon' and 완주하다 for finishing the whole course.

응급.x: If there's an emergency patient, call 119.

다큐멘터리.ex: 어제 바다 동물에 대한 다큐멘터리를 봤어요.
다큐멘터리.x: Yesterday I watched a documentary about sea animals.
다큐멘터리.e: From English 'documentary'; often shortened to 다큐.

찾아내다.m: to find out, discover, track down
찾아내다.x: The police tracked down the lost wallet.
찾아내다.e: 찾다 'to look for' + -아 내다 'manage to, all the way'.

상승.x: Living costs have gone up a lot due to rising prices.

기부금.x: The donations collected will be given to neighbors in need.

피로감.ex: 요즘은 아무리 자도 피로감이 계속 남아 있어요.
피로감.x: These days, no matter how much I sleep, the tiredness doesn't go away.

이산화탄소.x: Cars give off a lot of carbon dioxide.
이산화탄소.e: Literally 'carbon with two oxygens' — the chemical name for CO2.

북극.x: Polar bears are in danger because the Arctic ice is shrinking.
북극.t: Pronounced [북끅]: ㄱ becomes tense after the ㄱ batchim.

기어이.m: at all costs, determinedly; in the end, finally
기어이.ex: 그는 반대를 무릅쓰고 기어이 유학을 떠났어요.
기어이.x: Despite the opposition, he insisted on going to study abroad.
기어이.e: Literally 'aiming at (the goal)' plus -이: refusing to stop until it's done.

비하다.forms: Mostly as connectors: N에 비해 · N에 비하여 · N에 비하면
비하다.m: to compare (to), to be in comparison with
비하다.ex: 올해는 작년에 비해 비가 많이 왔어요.
비하다.x: Compared to last year, it rained a lot this year.
비하다.t: N에 비해(서) means 'compared to N' and is one of the most common comparison patterns in TOPIK writing.

짊어지다.m: to carry on one's back; to shoulder (a burden, responsibility)
짊어지다.x: He shouldered his family's livelihood all by himself.
짊어지다.e: Related to 지다 'to carry on one's back'.

허물다.forms: 허물어요 · 허물었어요 · 허물 거예요 · 허무세요 (ㄹ drops)
허물다.m: to tear down, demolish; to break down (barriers)
허물다.x: They tore down the old building and made a park.
허물다.e: Homonym warning: the noun 허물 means 'fault' or 'shed skin'.

힘을 쓰다.forms: 힘을 써요 · 힘을 썼어요 · 힘써 주셔서 감사합니다 (ㅡ drops)
힘을 쓰다.m: to use one's strength; to make an effort; to use one's influence
힘을 쓰다.ex: 아버지가 힘을 써서 무거운 상자를 옮기셨어요.
힘을 쓰다.x: Dad used all his strength to move the heavy box.
힘을 쓰다.e: Literally 'to use strength'; it can also mean pulling strings for someone.

흥정.x: I haggled over the price with the lady at the market.
흥정.e: Used with 하다; a classic traditional-market skill, together with asking for 덤.
흥정.t: To ask for a lower price, say 좀 깎아 주세요 'please give me a discount'.

암호화.ex: 개인 정보는 반드시 암호화해서 저장해야 합니다.
암호화.x: Personal information must be encrypted before it is stored.

배은망덕.ex: 도와준 사람을 배신하다니 정말 배은망덕한 행동이에요.
배은망덕.x: Betraying the person who helped you is truly ungrateful behavior.
배은망덕.e: Literally 'turning one's back on kindness and forgetting favors.'
배은망덕.t: Usually 배은망덕하다 or 배은망덕한 + noun; a strong, harsh criticism.

물불을 가리지 않다.forms: 물불을 가리지 않아요 · 물불을 가리지 않았어요 · 물불을 안 가리고
물불을 가리지 않다.m: to stop at nothing; to go through fire and water
물불을 가리지 않다.ex: 그는 성공을 위해서라면 물불을 가리지 않아요.
물불을 가리지 않다.x: He'll stop at nothing to succeed.
물불을 가리지 않다.e: Literally 'not telling water from fire' — no danger is too great.

여론전.m: battle for public opinion, PR war
여론전.ex: 선거를 앞두고 두 정당의 여론전이 치열해지고 있습니다.
여론전.x: Ahead of the election, the two parties' battle for public opinion is heating up.

천주교.x: My grandmother lived as a Catholic her whole life.
천주교.e: Literally 'teaching of the Lord of Heaven', the old Chinese name for God.

외교부.ex: 외교부는 그 나라에 대한 여행 경보를 발령했습니다.
외교부.x: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a travel warning for that country.
외교부.t: The head is 외교부 장관, the Korean equivalent of the US Secretary of State.

아토피.ex: 아이가 아토피가 있어서 피부가 자주 가려워요.
아토피.x: My child has eczema, so their skin often itches.
아토피.e: From English 'atopy'; Koreans use it for the skin condition, atopic dermatitis.

증가폭.m: size of an increase, margin of growth
증가폭.ex: 취업자 수의 증가폭이 지난달보다 크게 줄었습니다.
증가폭.x: The increase in the number of employed people shrank sharply from last month.

채무자.ex: 채무자가 돈을 갚지 않고 연락을 끊어 버렸습니다.
채무자.x: The debtor cut off contact without paying the money back.

조상숭배.x: Jesa ancestral rites began from the tradition of ancestor worship.

집단면역.ex: 인구의 70% 이상이 백신을 맞아야 집단면역이 생깁니다.
집단면역.x: More than 70% of the population must be vaccinated for herd immunity to form.

부도체.x: Rubber is an insulator that doesn't conduct electricity.
부도체.t: The prefix 불- becomes 부- before ㄷ and ㅈ: 부도체, 부족, 부정.

전광석화.x: He caught the ball as fast as lightning.
전광석화.e: Literally 'a lightning flash, a spark from struck stone'.

홀연히.ex: 그는 어느 날 홀연히 마을을 떠났어요.
홀연히.x: One day, he suddenly left the village.
홀연히.e: Literally 'suddenly so': appearing or vanishing without warning.

양립하다.x: It's not easy for work and child-rearing to go hand in hand.
양립하다.e: Literally 'both stand': two things that can exist together.
양립하다.t: Pronounced [양니파다]. Often negative: A와 B는 양립할 수 없다.

구조화.ex: 글을 쓰기 전에 생각을 구조화해 보세요.
구조화.x: Try structuring your thoughts before you write.

읍참마속.m: sacrificing someone dear for the sake of discipline or principle
읍참마속.ex: 감독은 읍참마속의 심정으로 주장을 경기에서 제외했습니다.
읍참마속.x: With a heavy heart, the coach dropped the captain from the game for the sake of discipline.
읍참마속.e: From Three Kingdoms: Zhuge Liang tearfully executed his favorite general Ma Su for disobeying orders.
읍참마속.t: Typically appears as 읍참마속의 심정으로 'with the heart of one who must punish a loved one.'
